summary: Mobile-focused regression pass on the wedding invitation site. Tested at 390x844 (mobile), 768x1024 (tablet), 1440x900 (desktop). No horizontal overflow at any breakpoint at any scroll position. Envelope intro screen fits and is centered on mobile. All 6 target sections (hero, invitation, countdown, family, venue, footer) found and render at exact viewport width. Regression removals confirmed: no nav, audio, music player, events/gallery/rsvp sections. Floating petals still present (19 in DOM; enhancements.css hides half visually under 640px).

issues: Decorative .mandala/.hero-mandala/.venue-mandala elements extend beyond viewport (right=~429px on 390px screen) but are clipped by html/body overflow-x:hidden so no horizontal scrollbar appears. Not a bug — informational only.

critical_code_review_comments: Mobile polish achieved via overflow-x:hidden on html/body — works, but decorative mandalas still overflow their container. Consider constraining them with max-width:100vw or transform-scale for cleaner mobile layout (cosmetic only).
Countdown DOM count returned 22 boxes on scan; visually the 2x2 grid renders correctly (screenshot confirms 4 primary count boxes). No action needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile responsiveness verified end-to-end. Envelope button data-testid='open-invitation-button' works. All section data-testids exist: hero-section, invitation-section, countdown-section, family-section, venue-section, site-footer. Doc height on mobile ~5419px. Use overflow check: document.documentElement.scrollWidth === window.innerWidth at multiple scroll Ys.
